doc.name: THE MOON
doc.title: THE NIGHT'S LANTERN
doc.blurb: The menu's own moon at its seat, upgraded to tonight's true phase (days since 2000-01-06T18:14Z over 29.530589, mod 1), with the maria, Tycho and its rays, and earthshine on the dark face. On the MENU SKY board dial D13 keeps the shipped crescent until flipped.
